title: Email
description: Mails a notification to the person it is for, at the address they sign in with, once they turn it on: an email channel of theirs, part of their person item, says whether mail is on, their quiet hours and the least level worth a mail. Nobody is mailed who has not turned it on.

types.title: Email channel
types.description: How a person is reached by mail: part of their person item. Mail goes to the address they sign in with, never another. Off unless turned on.

on.description: Whether notifications are mailed. Off unless turned on.

least.description: The least level of notification mailed.

quiet_from.description: When quiet hours begin, as HH:MM: nothing but an urgent notification is mailed until they end.

quiet_to.description: When quiet hours end, as HH:MM.

zone.description: The time zone quiet hours are in (e.g. Europe/London); the workspace's unless said.
